display_name: Wolfsberg Payment Transparency & LEI Binding Linter
purpose: Full ISO 17442 LEI check-digit validation via ISO 7064 Mod 97-10 for originator and beneficiary LEIs in pacs.008. Also scores Wolfsberg Payment Transparency Standards across six fields (originator name, account, LEI; beneficiary name, account, LEI) and assigns a transparency tier (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW). LEIs are public GLEIF registry data -- no PII involved. For format-only LEI checks within broader party completeness validation use validate_pacs008_party_completeness (art-242).
